'''2008 Worlds Team Chris Wirs LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Wirs]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title WYS Beats. Sheet spelling Chris Wira / Wirs kept as Wirs from header.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Wirs]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
